One sovereign platform that optimizes and secures dual-use factories, heavy industry, and

Lower Year-1 cost vs Palantir (Standard tier)
€1.5 Billion. EU Defence Is No Longer Talk.

On 30 March 2026, the European Commission adopted a €1.5 billion work programme under
        the European Defence Industry Programme (EDIP). €700M+ flows into production ramp-up.
        €240M into joint procurement. €100M into equity for defence SMEs. Every recipient
        needs sovereign compliance infrastructure. Aegis is the only EU-sovereign platform covering
        the full regulatory stack — ETS, CBAM, CSRD, NIS2, EU AI Act, and dual-use export
        control — in a single tenant.
Defence Supply Chains Have a Regulatory Collision

EU defence contractors and their supply chains face ETS, CBAM, CSRD, NIS2, KRITIS, and EU AI
        Act simultaneously. When a lime facility burns in Finland, the cascade hits steel flux,
        cement feedstock, chemical precursors, and construction embodied carbon within days. No
        existing platform connects this chain. US platforms are CLOUD Act exposed and cannot serve
        EU sovereign defence procurement.
Six Core Agents. One Governed Platform.

Dual-use export control (Reg. 2021/821) plus CSRD, CBAM, ETS, NIS2. Cross-regulation
            scoring.
CLOUD Act exposure detection. EU data residency verification. Four sovereignty tiers.

Steel and metals — ETS Phase 4, CBAM carbon declarations. Defence supply chain steel
            visibility.

Cement, lime, earth materials. Dual-use critical raw material assessment under EU CRM
            Act.

Supply chain signal propagation across 21 industries. One disruption, five industries,
            one ledger.

Know Your Agent — hardware-attested identity, Firecracker MicroVM isolation, kill-switch
            authority. Your agents can transact on AP2/UCP/ACP rails; every mandate is gated by a
            checkable trust score and logged to EU AI Act Article 12 evidence.

Plus 12+ additional agents: SiteSense, MaterialOracle, ScheduleGenius, Article12Logger,
        ArgusAgent (orbital intelligence, roadmap), and more.

Market signal (June 2026): the U.S. Army made Palantir Foundry its NGC2 cloud data layer and
        Anduril Lattice its tactical data layer — proof that command-and-control is won at the
        sovereign data layer. Europe has no equivalent baseline; the U.S. stack carries CLOUD Act
        exposure and an EU AI Act gap. Aegis is the EU-sovereign answer.
PiTuKri audited; ISO 27001 / SOC 2 in progress
Zero exposure — no US parent, no US infrastructure
Zero egress costs on all tiers. All prices exclude VAT. Annual billing available.
No hardware is bundled or resold at any tier.

DWS supplies the software
        platform and the governance layer only. Defence-tier GPU inference runs on L40S nodes inside
        the EU-hosted single-tenant cluster — nothing is shipped to site. Sovereign
        on-premises and air-gapped deployments run on customer- or partner-procured hardware,
        scoped per engagement.

The models we adopt ship as open weights, so the
        inference layer is portable by design rather than tied to one vendor's stack. A non-NVIDIA
        fallback path (AMD, Intel accelerators) is carried in our supply-risk plan, and hardware
        compatibility is validated per engagement rather than assumed. The full supply-risk register
        is available under NDA.
